fact: The Ghana Revenue Authority says domestic taxpayers pay taxes on the Ghana.gov platform by bank card, QR code, mobile money USSD and bank transfers, and at 22 designated banks, from 1 May 2021.
The chapter says GRA's ITAPS, introduced in 2019, facilitates online payment and record keeping for domestic taxes by taxpayers.
Vice President Bawumia listed the filing of tax returns among the services reachable through the CADIS app launched on 7 October 2024, without saying tax can be paid there.
Ghana Police say traffic fines notified under TraffiTech-GH from 1 November 2026 can be paid electronically by mobile money or card within 14 days.
President Akufo-Addo said the Ghana.gov portal has facilitated transactions worth some GH¢1.6 billion since 2019, improving revenue collection.
